featured_reviews.name: SK AYUB
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re craving a hearty, juicy seekh kabab with all the right spices and smoky flavor, Laziz Seekh Kabab Corner is a must-visit spot! Hidden in plain sight, this local gem offers an unforgettable dining experience for those who love their food loaded with flavor and cooked to perfection.

Ambiance

The atmosphere at Laziz Seekh Kabab Corner is casual and unpretentious. The small, cozy setting creates a welcoming vibe, perfect for grabbing a quick meal or enjoying a laid-back dinner with friends. It's not overly flashy, but the focus here is all about the food, and they deliver in that department!

Food & Quality

When it comes to the kababs themselves, the star of the show is undeniably the seekh kebabs. The meat is always fresh, tender, and bursting with a perfectly balanced blend of spices. Each bite delivers a satisfying combination of savory flavors, with just the right amount of heat to keep things interesting. The kababs are expertly grilled, leaving them with a mouthwatering smokiness that's hard to beat.

The menu also features other items like chicken tikka, reshmi kebabs, and naan, which pair beautifully with the seekh kebabs. The naan is soft and fluffy, and the dips (like mint chutney and raita) complement the kababs wonderfully, adding a fresh and tangy contrast.

Service

The service is quick and efficient, and the staff is friendly, often going out of their way to make sure your experience is a great one. Whether you're a regular or a first-timer, you're treated like an old friend. Expect the food to arrive hot and fresh, making every bite worth the wait.

Price

Laziz Seekh Kabab Corner offers great value for money. The prices are very reasonable, especially considering the quality of food you’re getting. You won’t feel like you're breaking the bank, but you'll definitely leave feeling satisfied.

Pizza Hut today feels like just a name — the quality and standards have completely collapsed.

To Pizza Hut Management:

This is not an isolated issue. If you have people managing your outlets, either they are absent or simply not doing their jobs. Immediate changes are needed.

Hire proper staff.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Overall rating: 4.3/5

Since a while now, i have been quite disheartened by the momos from my favourite momo spots. They are more onion, and less chicken. This might be to catch up with the inflation in the prices of chicken, but it has massively affected the taste, especially for me who is strongly averse to the taste of onions.

After coming across a lot of Instagram influencers promoting the Chinese Thali at Priya Fast Foos, which looks oh-so-tempting, it was no suprise that I planned my weekend outing to irla at the earliest to taste it.

As you might have already guessed, it was a visit worth remembering. A hidden gem, this stall at the corner of irla's shopping lane is a must visit. And my favourite item here were their chicken steamed momos. Had one plate of that, followers by the Chinese Thali. Though the momos were incredibly delicious & very light on the pocket, there was no space left in our stomachs to try their varietys. And after long, i can happily say that onions weren't the primary ingredient of the momos.

The Chinese Thali (chicken) is priced at 210/- & includes a portion of noodles, Schezwan fried rice, chicken chilli gravy, 2 chicken lollipop, 2 steamed momos & 2 fried momos.

Except the lollipop, all the other items were quite delectable. A must visit !
